title: Databox Review (2026)
intro: Databox is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Databox is a KPI dashboard and business analytics platform — connect marketing, sales, and product data sources into shareable dashboards and scorecards. Freemium with paid tiers (2026-08-19 — confirm on databox.com/pricing). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Databox when marketing analytics visibility is the job.
verdict: Choose Databox when marketing analytics visibility is the job. Compare Brand24 for social listening analytics. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
